features.name: Record the screen
features.says: Press the shortcut and Scrawl records the display under the pointer once the keys come up, with a red edge glow as the cue.

shortcuts.does: Start or finish a capture (Alt+Shift+S on Windows and Linux)

features.name: Switch target as it starts
features.says: The capsule opens onto Area · Window · Screen · iPhone for 3.5 s; a chip restarts the capture on that target.
features.note: The iPhone chip is Mac only.

features.name: Choose What to Record…
features.says: The menu's picker opens on the pointer's display: drag an area, click a window, or pick Screen or iPhone.
features.note: The Linux preview's Window mode lists X11 windows only.

features.name: Auto-crop
features.says: Screen captures crop each keyframe to the window or region you worked in; uncropped frames stay in frames-full/.

config.does: Turn auto-crop off or change its settings

features.name: More than one display
features.says: The picker, overlay and capsule follow the pointer between displays; each capture belongs to one display.

features.name: What to record and Recent Area
features.says: A Recording setting picks what the shortcut records, including the last area drawn, reused without another drag.

config.does: What the shortcut records
The last area recorded

features.name: Screenshots
features.says: ⌥⇧4 takes a still of an area, window or screen into a one-frame bundle.

shortcuts.does: Take a screenshot (with the screenshots flag)

features.name: Draw with ⇧
features.says: Hold ⇧ and move to draw red ink over any app; it fades after release and is redrawn on the keyframes.
features.note: On Wayland the Linux preview needs the input group for ink outside its own windows.

features.name: Pins
features.says: ⇧-click drops a numbered pin: a brief pulse on screen, a mark on the keyframe.

features.name: Undo and cancel
features.says: Undo removes the last stroke; Esc cancels the selection or the capture.

shortcuts.does: Undo the last stroke (Ctrl+Z on Windows)

features.name: Clicks pass through
features.says: Clicks, drags and scrolls reach the app underneath and are recorded; keyframes show a ripple.
features.note: Over Wayland apps the Linux preview's click positions can be stale.

features.name: Capsule
features.says: The capsule shows the time with Finish and Cancel on the display in use; on a Mac it's a native Metal panel, black or glass.
features.note: Windows and Linux draw the GPUI capsule; glass needs macOS 26.

config.does: Draw the GPUI capsule instead of the Metal one (Mac)
The Metal capsule's look

features.name: Own windows left out
features.says: Scrawl's capsule, picker and overlay, and macOS prompts over a Screen or Area capture, stay out of the recording.
features.note: Prompts are a macOS case. The Linux preview records its own windows and masks the capsule from keyframe picking.

features.name: Lower other audio
features.says: Ramps the output volume down to a set level while recording and back when it ends.
features.note: Uses CoreAudio through the helper.

config.does: Lower other audio while recording
Percent of the volume to keep

features.name: Transcribe while recording
features.says: Streams the microphone to Apple Speech during the capture, so finishing waits only for the last words.

features.name: Straight lines
features.says: Hold ⌥⇧ while drawing for a straight line from where the stroke began.

features.name: SwiftUI capsule
features.says: A SwiftUI capsule drawn by the helper in place of the Metal one, kept out of captures.

config.does: Which capsule to draw

features.name: Finish
features.says: Press the shortcut again or Finish; a press within 0.4 s of the start is ignored.

features.name: Copied, with a Paste chip
features.says: The summary text goes to the clipboard and the capsule shows Copied with a Paste chip; drag the chip onto a window to paste there.

features.name: Paste the latest capture
features.says: ⌥⇧V pastes the contact sheet and then the summary into the app in front.

shortcuts.does: Paste the latest capture (Alt+Shift+V on Windows and Linux)

features.name: Image and text on one clipboard
features.says: Copies the contact sheet with the text, so one Ctrl+V attaches the image in a browser or Electron composer.

features.name: Review window
features.says: Open Latest Capture shows the bundle's keyframes and timeline in a window.

features.name: Recover unbuilt captures
features.says: A capture whose bundle never got built (the app died first) is built at the next launch.

features.name: Capture stack
features.says: The finished frame flies into a card under the capsule or at the screen edge, to drag, open or send.

features.name: Run a command per capture
features.says: Runs your own command once each bundle is written, so any agent or script can receive captures.

config.does: Command to run for each capture
Its time limit

features.name: The bundle
features.says: A .scrawl folder with contact-sheet.png, frames/, summary.md, scrawl.json, the recording and audio.wav.

features.name: Contact sheet and frames
features.says: Keyframes in time order, each with a number chip, the ink and click ripples drawn on, and no captions.

features.name: Keyframe selection
features.says: Keyframes are cut on marks, clicks, flags and settled screen changes, never on speech pauses: 6 up to 40 s, at most 12.

features.name: summary.md
features.says: Each keyframe line gives what was done and the words said while it was on screen, split at clause boundaries.

features.name: Spoken cues
features.says: Saying “now”, “here”, “look” or “watch” cuts a keyframe when that screen differs from the ones already chosen.
features.note: Needs measured word times, so not from a Hex transcript.

features.name: Numbered marks
features.says: Several marks on one keyframe are numbered ①② in the text, never on the image; scrawl zoom --mark finds one.

features.name: Agent context
features.says: The summary names what clicks and marks land on, from Accessibility (UI Automation on Windows) and dev-page events.

features.name: Text under marks
features.says: Reads the text under a mark or drag with Vision when Accessibility can't name it (with agentContext).

features.name: Apple Speech
features.says: On-device transcription with word times: SpeechAnalyzer on macOS 26, SFSpeechRecognizer on macOS 15.
features.note: Windows and Linux use Parakeet on device.

config.does: Which engine transcribes
Apple Speech language; absent follows the Mac

features.name: Parakeet on device
features.says: Transcribes with Hex's Parakeet model, or downloads Scrawl's own copy (730 MB) at first launch.

features.name: Hex
features.says: Transcribes with whichever model a running Hex has ready; falls back to Apple Speech if Hex fails.
features.note: Hex's local API is Mac only.

config.does: Hex model to use
Language sent to Hex

features.name: Handy
features.says: Transcribes with the model chosen in an installed Handy, through its headless mode; falls back to Apple Speech if Handy fails.
features.note: Needs Handy 0.9.0 or later. On Windows, from Handy's install folder in %LOCALAPPDATA% or %ProgramFiles%.

features.name: Your own model
features.says: Runs your own program on the audio and reads a JSON transcript from it.
features.note: Windows runs it in a job object, without a console window.

config.does: Program to run
Its time limit

features.name: Dev-site captures to their session
features.says: A capture that ends on a localhost dev site goes to that project's newest OpenCode session, and is still copied.
features.note: Reads the browser's tab URL, which only the Mac does; /sdk.js registrations route everywhere.

config.does: Keep dev-site captures on the clipboard

features.name: /sdk.js page registration
features.says: A dev page that loads Scrawl's /sdk.js names its session or project folder.

features.name: Smart routing
features.says: Weighs more clues (tab, Ghostty pane, window title, transcript) and sends with a 3 s undo, or offers a choice.

config.does: Checkouts for apps and folders for file servers

features.name: Retries
features.says: A send OpenCode didn't take is retried every 15 s, backing off to 30 min, for a day.

features.name: Agent on another Mac
features.says: Sends captures to the OpenCode server on another Mac over SSH, copying the bundle there first.

config.does: SSH host whose OpenCode holds the sessions
The opencode command on that host

features.name: Agents on other machines
features.says: Syncs captures to remote agent hosts and pastes the remote paths.

config.does: Where captures go on the remote host

features.name: Safer delivery defaults
features.says: Ingest listens on loopback only, automatic delivery becomes opt-in, and pairing changes ask first.

features.name: Cabled iPhone
features.says: Pick iPhone with a phone plugged in: a mirror opens, the phone's own video records with your narration, and ink works over the mirror.
features.note: Needs AVFoundation's screen capture devices.

features.name: ScrawlKit
features.says: A Swift package for your iOS app: a three-finger long press records the app with narration, touches, strokes and events.
features.note: iOS 18+; recordings go to Scrawl on a Mac.

features.name: HTTPS endpoint and outbox
features.says: A setup link can point at an HTTPS endpoint; recordings queue on the phone and upload in the background with retries.
features.note: Phone side; no Mac needed.

features.name: App context
features.says: The app names its screen and adds key/values, which the summary shows beside each keyframe.
features.note: Phone side.

features.name: Host app hooks
features.says: A team endpoint, a timeline supplement and a submit hook let a host app handle recordings itself.
features.note: Phone side.

features.name: Pairing link
features.says: scrawl link prints a setup link and QR code with this Mac's Tailscale and LAN addresses; usbApps adds a cabled fallback.
features.note: The iPhone path is Mac only.

config.does: Bearer token for phone uploads
Apps whose recordings come over USB

features.name: Import a recording
features.says: scrawl import builds a bundle from an AirDropped .mp4 and its timeline.
features.note: The iPhone path is Mac only.

features.name: Headless ingest
features.says: scrawl serve takes ScrawlKit uploads on an always-on Mac without the app running.
features.note: The iPhone path is Mac only.

features.name: Settings window
features.says: General, Recording, Storage, Permissions, Agents and About, from the menu's Settings….

features.name: Custom shortcuts
features.says: Record new keys for Record and Paste; Scrawl turns down combinations the system or another app uses, and Paste can be turned off.

config.does: Both shortcuts; paste null turns it off

features.name: Launch at login
features.says: A switch in General.

features.name: Microphone
features.says: Pick an input with a live level meter; a missing device falls back to the default and says so.
features.note: Windows and Linux record from the default input.

config.does: Chosen input; absent follows the system

features.name: Keep recordings
features.says: Video and audio go to the Trash after 7 days and whole bundles after 30; Settings › Storage picks 7, 30 days or Forever.

config.does: How long to keep media and bundles; null keeps forever

features.name: Hourly cleanup
features.says: Cleanup passes run hourly instead of daily and take zoom/ sheets with the media.

features.name: Pin a capture
features.says: scrawl pin keeps a capture out of cleanup; scrawl clean --dry-run shows what a pass would do.

features.name: Shrink iPhone video
features.says: A minute after a cabled capture, its video is re-encoded to HEVC at 1600 px (750 MB to 72 MB in one test).
features.note: The iPhone path is Mac only.

features.name: Choose the captures folder
features.says: Settings › Storage picks where new captures go instead of Application Support; an unusable folder falls back to the built-in one.
features.note: The Change… button is Mac only; elsewhere set capturesDir.

config.does: Where captures are written

features.name: Command-line tool
features.says: Settings › Agents links scrawl onto PATH and it always runs the app's current copy; Homebrew links it too.
features.note: Windows gets a scrawl.cmd shim.

features.name: Agent skill
features.says: bunx skills add kitlangton/scrawl teaches an agent to read a paste and use the CLI; scrawl skill prints it.

features.name: scrawl zoom
features.says: A dense sheet of frames around a time, a phrase that was said, or a numbered mark.

features.name: inspect and frames
features.says: Print summary.md, scrawl.json or the marks; pull plain PNGs of a time range.

features.name: send and route
features.says: Queue a capture into a session (refusing a different one than recorded without --reroute); see where a URL would route.

features.name: reprocess
features.says: Rebuild a bundle with the current rules, another transcriber, or an experiment turned on.

features.name: Auto-crop playground
features.says: scrawl autocrop --serve opens sliders that run the real crop on a capture and copy the settings as JSON.

features.name: scrawl export
features.says: One .mp4 with ink, pins and clicks burned in, cropped to the activity, audio in sync; --zoom eases toward clicks and marks.
features.note: Rendered with AVFoundation in the helper.

features.name: Export from the menu
features.says: Export Last Capture as Video… saves to ~/Movies/Scrawl with progress beside the menu bar icon.

config.does: Show Export Last Capture as Video… (Settings › Recording › Experimental)

features.name: Mac download and Homebrew
features.says: A notarized DMG for Apple silicon, or brew install --cask kitlangton/tap/scrawl.
features.note: Windows has its own zip.

features.name: Automatic updates
features.says: The Mac app updates itself with Sparkle; Check for Updates… is in the menu and Settings › About.
features.note: On Windows and Linux, Check for Updates… opens the releases page.

features.name: Windows zip
features.says: scrawl.exe for Windows 10 (2004) and later on x64, unsigned, without automatic updates.

features.name: Linux AppImage
features.says: AppImages for x86_64 and aarch64 (Ubuntu 24.04+), published by hand as linux-preview-N.

features.name: AUR package
features.says: yay -S scrawl-linux-bin installs the AppImage with a scrawl command.

features.name: Welcome tour
features.says: A welcome, an 11 s demo of ⌥⇧S, one permissions checklist and a first capture; it resumes where any quit left it.

config.does: Tour progress; delete it to replay the tour

features.name: Drag-in permission card
features.says: For Screen Recording and Accessibility, a card flies to System Settings so you drag Scrawl into the list.
features.note: Windows only asks for the microphone switch; Linux Wayland asks for the input group.

features.name: Reopens after a grant
features.says: If a Screen Recording grant doesn't reach the running app, Scrawl reopens itself on the same screen.
features.note: Only macOS caches the grant.

features.name: macOS
features.says: Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later; live transcription and Liquid Glass need macOS 26.

features.name: Windows
features.says: Windows 10 (2004) and later on x64: the same app, without the iPhone, export, Sparkle or the tab URL.

features.name: Linux preview
features.says: X11, and GNOME and KDE on Wayland through XWayland; without the iPhone, export, agent context, Sparkle or the tab URL.
